name: The jackal-headed god
aliases: the figure with a golden headdress
description: A towering jackal-headed being with a golden headdress and two-pronged staff who destroys the undead wurms and saves the Gatewatch.

timeline.summary: A blazing white arrow kills the wurm over Liliana and a towering jackal-headed figure destroys the others and saves the group.
timeline.quote: She towered above me, standing at the height of a dozen men, golden headdress gleaming in the sun

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes there are gods on Amonkhet, in the world of Bolas.

relations.note: She saves the Gatewatch from undead wurms.
relations.quote: And my friends were all alive because of them.

pages_say.description: A towering jackal-headed being with a golden headdress and two-pronged staff who destroys the undead wurms and saves the Gatewatch.
